newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian govt orders Eurobond issued by end of 1996.
newsitem.headline: Russian govt orders Eurobond issued by end of 1996.

text.p: The Russian government ordered its first Eurobond to be issued in dollars by the end of 1996, a resolution signed by Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin said.
The resolution, signed on November 4, but released to the press on Monday, said the interest and redemption payments on the Eurobond will be made in dollars.
Russia is currently conducting a road-show for the Eurobond in major international financial centres.
Finance Minister Alexander Livshits said previously the Eurobond would be issued by the end of November and its terms would be defined after the road-show was over on November 20.
He said the issue volume could be $500 million or less.
Bankers said attendance at the presentations was amazingly high and they expected the price to be around 300 or 335 basic points over U.S. Treasuries.
